messages:
maya: Heads-up — dry run for release/v2.5.0 showed a couple intermittent failures on CI. Can folks sweep flakies before cutoff today?
jonathan: Which tests are red? I can take the streaming/kv ones.
maya: @jonathan, main hits: test_streaming_kv_cache (2/6), test_model_warmup_timeout (1/4). Root build: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/1977654321 :warning:
ci-bot: Build 1977654321 — FAILED — 2 failing tests. See artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/1977654321 :robot_face:
alex: I ran test_streaming_kv_cache locally, reproduced with seed=42. Minimal repro below:
```
E       assert 0 == 1
E       +: 0
E       -: 1
tests/test_streaming.py:87: AssertionError
```
alex: The failure looks timing-related — KV evict happened earlier than expected when batching spike occurs.
ashley: If it's timing, maybe we should add retry/flaky marker and open a ticket for proper fix? Cutoff is 18:00 PT.
maya: Prefer to avoid adding flaky marks right before cut if we can. Can we stabilize by bumping the test timeout or adjusting batch window in test harness?
jonathan: I can try increasing the harness window and run 10 iterations. If it passes 10/10, i'll open PR to bump timeout + add comment.
sre-oncall: FYI, infra rolled a kernel patch yesterday (node-gpu-12); might explain timing shift. If we see correlated regressions across tests, we may rollback.
alex: Good catch — I can run the full suite against the node-gpu-11 AMI to compare.
maya: Also, reminder: version bump and changelog entry need to be in before cutoff. @alex can you add a short entry for kv-cache fix if you put up PR?
alex: yep — will include "stabilize kv cache test" and link to CI. PR draft in 15.
jonathan: For test_model_warmup_timeout, I saw a flake in scheduler under high qps. I’ll add a small increase to warmup timeout and include a regression test.
maya: Thanks. Plan: 1) Alex runs local AMI compare and opens PR for test fix + changelog. 2) Jonathan tweaks warmup timeout and runs 10 dry runs. 3) If both green by 17:30 PT we cut release branch. If still unstable, we revert node-gpu-12 roll or gate the release.
ci-bot: Note — queued jobs backlog is cleared. Current queue length: 3.
ashley: I'll watch the queue and coordinate the final green sweep. Ping me when you push PRs. :white_check_mark: 
maya: Ping @sre-oncall if you need an AMI rollback. Also tagging @ashley for cutover readiness.
jonathan: starting dry runs now. I'll post results in ~20m.
alex: PR up: https://git.redwood.ai/r/alex/kv-test-stabilize — timeout bump + comment + changelog stub. Running CI.
ci-bot: PR 4821 — CI: pending -> success.
jonathan: 10/10 dry runs passed locally. Opening PR with timeout bump: https://git.redwood.ai/r/jonathan/warmup-timeout
maya: Excellent. If both PRs merge before 17:30 PT, proceed with version bump to v2.5.0 and final green sweep.
ashley: I'll do the branch cut and smoke runs once merges land. Will post a short checklist when I start.
sre-oncall: Keeping an eye on infra — will rollback node-gpu-12 if more systemic flakes show up.
maya: Thanks team — low-key thread but huge impact. :heart:
